_form_note: Student_Attrition (Zoho form 'Student – Attrition'), built from Zoho_To_CHEDS_(23).ds field definitions + the push workflow 'push_api_production2' (POST .../Integration/Students/Attrition) + the four thisapp.Dropdown_Fields functions it calls (Gender, Student_Level_Code, Attrition_Category, Attrition_Reason -- their source IS in this .ds export, so every picklist map below is verified against the exact text those functions match on, not guessed). Raw column names = HEDB 'Student- Attrition' Database Field Names. institutionCode is hardcoded to 141 in the workflow, but Institution_code is a mandatory field on the form so it's still imported. Attrition_Reason uses the new 'value_map_by' option: the same code (TR) means different things under different categories, so the reason is resolved per row using that row's Attrition_Category -- and a reason that doesn't belong to its category is flagged rather than silently mapped. HEDB codes with NO matching choice on the Zoho form (will be flagged, need a form change before they can be imported): reason TI (VW Transportation Issues), TRP (Voluntary transfer to another program), TRM (Mandated transfer to another program); and category TR (Transfer to another program) currently has no valid reason choices on the form at all.

No conversion. Zoho field is a 15-digit Number. HEDB: use 999999999999999 if not available.
No conversion. Optional -- leave blank if not available. Note HEDB DB field name is 'Attrition_Name_Arabic' (no 'Student_').
